Home.Tagline: Training that suits you. A community that motivates you.
Home.Description: At CrossFit Leek, you train to become stronger, fitter, and more confident. Whether you have been exercising for years, are just starting out, or are looking to get back into shape, you train at your own level with expert coaching and a group of people who motivate one another.

Hero.subheadline: Training that fits you. A community that keeps you motivated.
Hero.body: At CrossFit Leek, you train to get stronger, fitter, and more confident. Whether you've been training for years, you're just starting out, or you're building back up: you train at your own level, with solid coaching and a group of people who motivate each other.
Hero.ctaIntro: Start with 2 trial weeks and discover if CrossFit Leek is right for you.

Intro.heading: More than a workout
paragraphs: At CrossFit Leek, it's not just about a good workout.
We want you to learn to move better, get stronger, and enjoy training.
That's why every session includes guidance from a coach who helps you perform the exercises correctly and safely.
lines: You don't have to be fit to start.
You don't need any CrossFit experience.
You only have to be willing to begin.

items.title: CrossFit
items.tagline: For those who want to improve everything.
items.description: Strength, conditioning, mobility, technique and skills come together in one complete training session. Every workout is different and scaled to your level.

items.title: Strength
items.description: Strength sessions focus on building general strength in the key lifts. You'll learn solid technique and get stronger step by step.

items.title: Endurance
items.description: During Endurance you're moving almost nonstop for 35–45 minutes. Ideal preparation for a hybrid competition, a survival run, or simply getting fitter.

items.title: SWEAT
items.tagline: Get fitter at your own level.
items.description: SWEAT is accessible for beginners and anyone picking up exercise again. You train at your own level in a small, motivating group.

items.title: Kids & Teens
items.description: We also offer training for kids and teens focused on movement, fun and development. They learn to move stronger and better, work together, and build confidence in what they can do.

items.title: Personal Training
items.description: With Personal Training you get one-on-one coaching fully tailored to your body, experience and goal.

WhyUs.heading: Why CrossFit Leek?
WhyUs.subheading: With us you know what to do, why you're doing it, and how to get better.

items.title: Coaching
items.description: You're never on your own. Our coaches guide you through every session and help you move better.

items.title: For every level
items.description: From complete beginner to experienced athlete: exercises and weights are scaled to your level.

items.title: Real progress
items.description: You're not just training to get tired. We work on strength, conditioning, technique, mobility and skills that actually move you forward.

items.title: Community
items.description: You come for the training, but you stay for the people. At CrossFit Leek we know each other, train together and celebrate each other's progress.

Testimonials.heading: You don't have to be fit to start
paragraphs: Never done CrossFit before? No problem.
You don't need to be able to do pull-ups. You don't need to lift a heavy barbell. And you certainly don't need to be in top shape.
Our coaches scale the training to your level.
Testimonials.closingLine: All you have to do is take the first step.
Testimonials.reviewsHeading: Our members say it better than we do

reviews.quote: The coaching and the community here really make the difference. I look forward to every session.

FinalCta.heading: Ready to get started?
FinalCta.subheading: Find out for yourself what CrossFit Leek can do for you.
FinalCta.paragraph: No experience needed. No perfect fitness level needed. Come train for two weeks, meet our coaches, and find out if CrossFit Leek is right for you.
